bio: Marvin is a Head of Content with 8+ years across finance, FX/CFD, crypto, and Web3. At mb.io, the crypto exchange arm of MultiBank Group, he owns the full content lifecycle across three brand accounts: the exchange, the $MBG Token, and the CEO's personal brand. Social calendars, long-form editorial, earn campaigns, paid ad copy, client comms, and the market intelligence that feeds all of it.

He's also the guy on the ground: lead organizer of mb.io's Platinum Sponsor booth at Istanbul Blockchain Week 2026, and the face of the brand at Binance Blockchain Week, RWA Week Dubai, Bitcoin Pizza Day at TheBlock, and Philippine Blockchain Week.

He holds an MBA in Digital Marketing from King's Business School and a BFA in Creative Writing from Ateneo de Manila University, which is a polite way of saying he's been professionally overthinking words since 2014.
He has ADHD. This is not a disclaimer. This is the source code. The hyperfocus is a feature, not a bug.

When he's not writing copy that moves markets, he's underwater (licensed scuba and cave diver), underground (spelunker), or somewhere in his 30th+ country with no particular agenda. He lives in Dubai. His plants are alive. That's the win.

funFacts.label: Built an AI content dashboard in-role

howIWork.heading: How I work: AI-native, by default
paragraphs: I don't just use AI tools, I build them. To run three brand accounts and eleven content pillars without a full content team, I designed and shipped the mb.io Content Dashboard: a scheduling and approval system, an AI writing agent trained on each brand's voice, a blog manager running a 100+ topic roadmap, and a pillar detection engine that flags coverage gaps before they happen.

The same logic runs through everything: AI video production (Higgsfield, Kling), agentic content workflows in Claude Code, and market monitoring pipelines that turn crypto, macro, and RWA feeds into a weekly Monday Outlook. The result is a one-person content operation with the output of a team.
